mu_name: The larger stone a meteor throws out where it lands
mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp: `for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) AccessModel(MODEL_STONE1 + i, L"Data\\Skill\\", L"Stone", i + 1)`, so this is Data/Skill/Stone02.bmd, MODEL_STONE2.
why_this_one: The other half of the meteor's debris. The landing rolls `MODEL_STONE1 + rand() % 2` six times, so each of the six is one of these two; see Stone01.json, which carries the whole of the argument and the flight.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Skill/Stone02.bmd, from MuMain. Thirty-eight triangles in one mesh, about 24 units across - a lump, against Stone01's 13-unit chip.

parts.note: Data/Skill/fire02.OZJ, the same sheet the chip and the meteor's own rock wear. Drawn solid and lit, on the bones' rule.

scale_from: As Stone01's: the shared birth rolls 0.8 to 1.1 and this is the base it multiplies.
lift_from: As Stone01's: created at the meteor's own landing point, which is already on the terrain.
flight_note: The bones' ballistic arm, shared outright. See Stone01.json and assets/effects/bones/Bone01.json.
